units.source_text: 总而言之，这两页本应收入《十六岁的日记》里的，却把它遗漏了。

en.t: In short, these two pages should have been included in Sixteen-Year-Old's Diary, but they were left out.

units.source_text: 虽然没有标明日期，但肯定是前头的继续，因此姑且在这里把它抄录下来。

en.t: Although no date is given, they are certainly a continuation of what came before, so I will copy them down here for the time being.

units.source_text: 然后，我准备撕掉这两页。

en.t: After that, I intend to tear out these two pages.
